# HAX art

> Artwork for HAX (https://haxtheweb.org), open-source tools for creating, remixing and publishing web content without needing to understand the web. The mascot is the World Traveler: a red-helmeted time traveler in steampunk goggles who carries the best ideas of every era into the future. Tagline: "Dream it, remix it, have it, share it."

Most variants are AI-generated remixes of the original human-made character; several parody other works and need review before official promotion. Attribution: HAX (haxtheweb), https://github.com/haxtheweb/art. Never rename or delete files: external sites hotlink them.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/haxtheweb/art/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repo map, usage guidance, contribution rules
- [manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haxtheweb/art/main/manifest.json): catalog of all 36 World Traveler images with alt text, style tags, setting, third-party flags
- [World Traveler story and character sheet](https://github.com/haxtheweb/art/blob/main/world-traveler/README.md)
- [Contact sheet of all variants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haxtheweb/art/main/world-traveler/contact-sheet.jpg)
